acquisition method: Dd-MS2 spectra were acquired using a dynamic m/z range with a fixed first mass of 100 m/z.
alkylation reagent: reduced (50 mM DTT), and alkylated (100 mM iodoacetamide)
alkylation concentration: reduced (50 mM DTT), and alkylated (100 mM iodoacetamide)
cleavage agent: digested {18 h at 36°C using a trypsin/LysC mixture [Promega, 1:50 (w/w)]}
collision energy: The 12 most abundant ions were selected for fragmentation using 30% normalized high collision energy.
fractionation method: High-pH RPLC fractionation was performed as described previously.
fragmentation method: The 12 most abundant ions were selected for fragmentation using 30% normalized high collision energy.
instrument: Skeletal muscle samples were analyzed using an UltiMate 3000 Nano LC Systems coupled to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer
labeling: Tandem mass tag (TMT) labeling was performed according to the manufacturer’s instructions (TMT6plex, Thermo Fisher, Cat# 90066).
reduction reagent: reduced (50 mM DTT), and alkylated (100 mM iodoacetamide)
reduction concentration: reduced (50 mM DTT), and alkylated (100 mM iodoacetamide)
